description_en: Queries the list of join permissions rented by the current user account. The join permissions can be dedicated or roaming join permissions
description_zh: 查询当前用户账号所租用的入网凭证列表（可能是专用入网凭证或泛在入网凭证）
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-rented-join-permissions --fuzzy-owner-aliyun-id some-user --fuzzy-join-eui d896e0 --enabled true --bound-node-group true --type LOCAL --fuzzy-join-permission-name '凭证1' --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending false --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRentedJoinPermissions

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the join permission owner for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID
parameters.name: fuzzy_owner_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The JoinEUI used by the join permission for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证使用的JoinEUI
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_eui

parameters.help_en: Filters join permissions by enabled or disabled status. A value of true indicates enabled. A value of false indicates disabled
parameters.help_zh: 按照凭证的启停用状态进行过滤。true表示启用，false表示停用
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: Filters join permissions by whether they are associated with a node group. A value of true indicates associated. A value of false indicates not associated
parameters.help_zh: 根据入网凭证是否关联到节点分组进行过滤。true表示已关联，false表示未关联
parameters.name: bound_node_group

parameters.help_en:
Filters join permissions by type. Valid values:

LOCAL: dedicated join permission
ROAMING: roaming join permission
parameters.help_zh:
按照入网凭证的类型进行过滤，取值：

LOCAL：专用凭证
ROAMING：泛在凭证
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the join permission for fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 模糊匹配入网凭证的名称
parameters.name: fuzzy_join_permission_name

parameters.help_en: The offset of the query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从 0 开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of join permissions to return. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的入网凭证数量的上限，大于等于 1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Set the value to CREATED_MILLIS to sort by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为CREATED_MILLIS, 表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies the sort order. Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending
